newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 23.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Assembly adjourns for Christmas break after adopting 1997 budget.
- Guinea's Prime Minister Sidya Toure ends visit to Ivory Coast after two countries signed accord on border cooperation.
- Ivorian group Octide, which holds a majority stake in leading Ivorian rubber company SAPH, embarks on promotion tour of West Africa after placing 20 percent of its stock on Abidjan bourse.
- Togo's Alexis Looki elected president of regional property bourse created at meeting in Cotonou, Benin, last week.
